senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. בָּלָה)to fade, shrivel, decay.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:2:2">Y. R. Hash. I, 56ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הֶעָלֶה נוֹבֵל</he>, v. <cite ref="B00254"><he>בּוּל</he> III</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:3">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 40:7">Is. XL, 7</cite>) <he>יבש חצירו … ונ׳ ציצו וכ׳</he> Abimelech’s grass is dried up and his flower has faded, but &c.; a. e.—V. <cite ref="N00298"><he>נוֹבֶלֶת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to cause fading; to ruin, deface; to disgrace. Y. Shebi. I, beg. 33ᵃ מיכן ואילך הוא מְנַבֵּל פירותיו after that time (by ploughing an orchard field after the Feast of Weeks) he causes deterioration of his fruits. Ib. IV, 35ᵇ bot.; Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55ᵈ אילן שהוא מנבל פירותיו a tree which fails to mature its fruits; (Ḥull. 77ᵇ; Sabb. 67ᵃ שמַשִּׁיר, v. נָשַׁר). Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ; Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵃ bot. צאהו נַבְּלֵיהוּ treat him (the idol) like excrements, make him abominable (change his name cacophemistically).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16:4">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite> <he>מנבל את עצמו בטיט</he> he begrimes himself by working in clay.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אל תְּנַבְּלוּ וכ׳</he> do not degrade yourselves by any evil thing (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 11:43">Lev. XI, 43</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 19:28">XIX, 28</cite>); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:5">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:5">Ib.</cite> (ed. Amst. p. 240ᵇ) <he>המְנַבֶּלֶת עצמה</he> who neglects her appearance, opp. <he>מקשטת</he>.

Ber. 63ᵇ (ref. to Prov. XXX, 32 נָבַלְתָּ) כל המנבל עצמו על וכ׳ he who lowers himself (exposes his ignorance) for the sake of learning, shall finally be raised; Midr. Prov. to ch. XXX אם נִבֵּל וכ׳; Gen. R. s. 81 אם נִבַּלְתָּ עצמך; Ab. d’R. N. ch. XI אם מנבל אדם עצמו וכ׳ if a man makes himself look offensive (through privations) &c.—Midr. Prov. l. c. (ref. to Prov. l. c.) זו יון שגזרו לנַבֵּל נשותיהן וכ׳ (not לבטל) that means the Greeks who decreed to disgrace Israel’s women; a. fr.—נ׳ פיו to make one’s mouth turpid, to talk obscenely.

senses.gloss: (denom. of נְבֵלָה) to make an animal ritually forbidden by unskillful slaughtering.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:10">Tosef. B. Kam. X, 10</cite> <he>המוסר … ונִיבְּלָהּ</he> if one entrusts his animal to a slaughterer, and he makes it unfit, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to be defaced, degraded, disgraced. Y. Yeb. XII, end, 13ᵃ מי גרם לך להִתְנַבֵּל וכ׳ what was the cause of thy disgrace (exposure of thy ignorance) in the Law?; Gen. R. l. c. Y. Keth. IV, 28ᵈ top. יִתְנַבְּלוּ הן וכ׳ they and their offspring shall be disgraced; a. e.
to become ritually forbidden (נְבֵלָה) by unskillful slaughtering.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 6:2">Ḥull. VI, 2</cite> <he>השוחט ונִתְנַבְּלָה בידו</he> if one cuts an animal and it becomes unfit under his hand; <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 5:3">ib. V, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 5:3">Tosef. ib. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 6:3">VI</cite>), 3; a. e.
